title: Generis Group Named One of Canada’s Top Growing Companies 2025 by The Globe and Mail
summary: Generis Group has been named one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies for 2025 by The Globe and Mail’s Report on Business magazine. The post Generis Group Named One of Canada’s Top Growing Companies 2025 by The Globe and Mail appeared first on Emerald .
body_markdown:
Generis Group has been named one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies for 2025 by *The Globe and Mail* ’s Report on Business magazine, ranking #136 on the list of 400 companies with verified three-year revenue growth of 264%. The company is listed within the Entertainment category of this year’s ranking.
